zh.summary: 用自主代理验证企业环境中真实攻击路径的安全平台。
zh.judgment: 价值在可复现的风险和可执行修复；零误报与零干扰宣传仍需客户环境验证。
zh.replaces: 安全团队定期做人工红队测试，再手工汇总可利用路径和修复建议。
zh.product: 官网平台描述侦察、并行探索与验证攻击链，目标是发现真实入侵路径。HTTP 抓取被拒，本次通过公开网页核验；没有运行任何安全测试。
zh.customer: 大型企业安全团队是目标，买方可能是安全负责人及风险管理部门。需要持续验证防御的组织更可能有反复需求，但实际客户合同与部署数未确认。
zh.workflow: 公司描述从暴露面识别到路径验证，再给出优先修复指引。可评估交付是范围内、可复核的发现及修复后复测，使用必须有客户授权和明确环境边界。
zh.business_model: 未检索到公开价格。企业合同或服务结合软件是商业假设；专家参与、复核时间与环境复杂度可能影响每次测试成本。
zh.traction: 平台展示代理数量和低误报主张，均为公司披露。缺少独立测试集、客户事故对照与重复采购，不能把运行代理数当作已付费客户。
zh.moat: 红队方法、环境反馈和可复现攻击链可能积累优势。竞争来自人工安全服务和其他自动验证工具；能否优先找到真实高价值风险比自动化规模更重要。
zh.funding_read: 融资可支持研究和企业交付，无法替代可靠风险发现的证明。下一步看同一客户持续复测和修复闭环，避免用演示速度替代实际采购价值。
zh.risks: 范围配置失误或过强执行可能影响生产系统；错误的低风险结论也可能造成安全盲区。应核验授权控制、复核、撤销与故障停止机制。
zh.takeaway: 让自动发现带有可复核证据，并连接修复责任与复测。将专家知识用于缩短高价值验证流程，而不是只增加扫描量。
zh.watch_next: 看客户环境中的发现精度、人工复核量、修复周期和重复合同。按环境与授权范围分组，不把一套测试结果推广到全部企业。

en.summary: An autonomous security platform for validating real enterprise attack paths.
en.judgment: Reproducible risk and actionable remediation are the value; zero-noise and zero-disruption claims require environment-specific verification.
en.replaces: Periodic manual red-team engagements and manual aggregation of exploit paths and remediation.
en.product: The official platform describes reconnaissance, parallel exploration and attack-chain validation. HTTP retrieval was refused; public web material was reviewed. No security test was executed.
en.customer: Large security teams are the stated audience, with security leaders plausible buyers. Recurring defense validation can create repeated demand, but customer contracts and deployment counts were not established.
en.workflow: The described flow moves from attack-surface discovery to validation and prioritized remediation. A useful output is an authorized, reviewable finding plus retesting after a fix, within explicit customer scope.
en.business_model: Public prices were not found. Enterprise contracts or software combined with services are hypotheses. Expert involvement, review time and environment complexity affect engagement cost.
en.traction: Agent counts and low-false-positive claims are company-reported. Independent benchmarks, incident comparisons and repeat procurement were unavailable. Executed agents are not paying customers.
en.moat: Tradecraft, environmental feedback and reproducible paths could accumulate advantages. Human security services and other validation tools compete; finding valuable real risks matters more than scan volume.
en.funding_read: Financing supports research and delivery without validating detection quality. Repeat tests and remediation closure within the same customer are stronger milestones than demonstration speed.
en.risks: Wrong scope or excessive execution can affect production; incorrect low-risk conclusions can create blind spots. Authorization, review, revocation and stopping behavior require verification.
en.takeaway: Attach reviewable evidence to automated findings and connect them to remediation ownership and retesting. Use expertise to shorten valuable validation rather than merely increasing scans.
en.watch_next: Watch precision, human review, repair cycles and repeat contracts by environment and authorized scope. A single engagement cannot establish performance across all enterprises.
